newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Bank 30-day T-bill yield falls at 6.82p.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Bank 30-day T-bill yield falls at 6.82p.

text.p: Bangladesh Bank, the country's central bank, sold 30-day treasury bills worth 810 million taka with an yield at 6.82 percent against 6.94 percent previously at an auction on Saturday, a bank statement said.
The weighted average price was 99.43 taka per 100 taka against previous 99.44 taka.

The bank also sold 90-day treasury bills worth 120 million taka with a corresponding yield at 7.41 percent against 7.5 percent previously. The weighted average price against the bills was 98.18 taka per 100 taka against previous 98.16 taka.
